item.title: Police: Gang-related shootings in Clarksdale leave 1 dead, 2 injured

item.title: Louisville youth behavioral health center aims to serve more patients with expansion
item.description: One of northeast Mississippi’s major behavioral health centers for youth has celebrated an expansion. Officials gathered at Diamond Grove Center in Louisville on Tuesday for a ceremonial ribbon-cutting for a new, 24-bed facility. item.title: Senate Republicans vote down legislation to halt Iran war in Congress’ first vote on the conflict
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Senate Republicans voted down an effort Wednesday to halt President Donald Trump’s war against Iran, demonstrating early support for a conflict that has rapidly spread across the Middle East with no clear U.S. exit strategy. item.title: Thunder & Lightning: Mississippi State’s Self Inflicted Wounds Have To Be Cleaned Up
item.description: Mississippi State suffered a second straight loss in Hattiesburg Tuesday night, and once again, the Bulldogs were the architects of their own demise. Brian Hadad and Robbie Faulk discuss where it went wrong for State, and what Brian O’Connor’s team has to clean up before SEC play begins.
